name: @echoverse/desktop
description: EchoVerse desktop voice and chat app

scripts.dev: npm run build:preload && concurrently "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && electron . --dev"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:win: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:x64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:arm64: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.release:mac:intel: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never

author: EchoVerse
